facts: ItemStack.CODEC has lowercase count and optional components DataComponentPatch; SINGLE_ITEM_CODEC retains components without count.
ItemStack.parse returns CODEC.parse(...).resultOrPartial(...). On tested malformed ResourceLocation/wrong-type component it returns a partial same-item stack with that component dropped.
An invalid decoded filter can therefore broaden ordinary fuzzy matching. Source schema and installer must reject missing/malformed/misspelled component predicates before Minecraft loads the file.
ResourceLocation.CODEC validates identifier syntax, not membership in the four known CDG Mold profiles; whitelist membership is separately required.
native_test_scope: Actual Minecraft codec/maps with an opt-in synthetic guard-namespace ResourceLocation component and vanilla paper. Original CDG/FTB runtime/renderer not loaded. Actual unchanged FTB matcher tested separately on modeled host.
